name: io.github.tonyyang0504/alibaba_1688_open-mcp
description: 1688 (Alibaba China wholesale) — 一件代发 / 跨境专供 + 1688 Open Platform (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_pr

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_1688_OPEN_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: appKey of your 1688 Open Platform app (it is also the last URL path segment of every call).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_1688_OPEN_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: appSecret of the same app; signs every call (_aop_signature = uppercase hex HMAC-SHA1 over the urlPath from 'param2' + sorted name+value, https://open.1688.com/doc/signature.htm) and refreshes tokens.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_1688_OPEN_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: refresh_token from the OAuth getToken exchange (need_refresh_token=true, https://open.1688.com/doc/apiAuth.htm); valid for the service subscription period (up to half a year). Access tokens (10 hours) are minted from it.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_1688_OPEN_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Language of translated titles for search and product detail (country: en, ja, ko, es, …; see the API's developer reference).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_1688_OPEN_ORDER_FLOW
environmentVariables.description: fastCreateOrder flow: general (wholesale order), saleproxy / fenxiao (一件代发 dropshipping order; the seller must have authorised proxy sales), boutiquefenxiao, …
